summary: Join our Digital Marketing for Nonprofits Training Course. Gain essential skills to elevate your organization's online presence and maximize fundraising efforts
lede: Digital marketing for nonprofits links audience needs and campaign activity with supporter actions and mission objectives. For nonprofit communications, fundraising and digital teams, this course offers a structured way to plan campaigns, map donor and volunteer journeys, and choose channels. You’ll practise audience segmentation, SEO and content planning, conversion journey design, campaign tracking and performance reporting using frameworks such as RACE and SMART objectives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, deliver, measure, or approve nonprofit digital campaigns and need a structured way to connect online activity with mission and supporter outcomes.
outcomes: Basic SEO And Landing Page Optimization
prerequisites: No coding or advanced advertising experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with websites, email, social media, or nonprofit communications and bring one real campaign, programme, fundraising appeal, or outreach priority for applied exercises. A laptop is recommended. Access to live Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Meta Ads Manager, or Google Ads accounts is optional because exercises can use supplied datasets and templates.
